title: MOE Taiwan Scholarship Program
application_deadline: Varies by country (typically January–February each year via ROC overseas missions)
eligibility_summary: Foreign nationals with secondary school graduation or post-secondary degree, excellent academic record, good character. Not open to ROC nationals, overseas Chinese, or those already studying in Taiwan at same degree level. Maximum 5 years cumulative.
funding_details: Tuition and miscellaneous expenses up to NTD 40,000 per semester + monthly living allowance of NTD 15,000 (bachelor) or NTD 20,000 (master/doctoral).
duration: Bachelor: 4 years; Master: 2 years; Doctoral: 4 years (maximum cumulative 5 years)

title: MOE Huayu Enrichment Scholarship (HES)
application_deadline: Varies by country (typically January–February each year via ROC overseas missions)
eligibility_summary: Foreign persons at least 18 years old, graduated from secondary school or post-secondary level, excellent academic record, good moral character. Not open to ROC passport holders or those currently studying Chinese in Taiwan.
duration: 2 months (summer), 3 months, 6 months, 9 months, or 12 months

title: MOE Short Term Research Award (STRA)
application_deadline: September 30 each year (to host institution in Taiwan)
eligibility_summary: International scholars (excluding mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao) who are PhD students at overseas approved universities or postdoctoral fellows. Must not hold ROC passport, not currently in Taiwan, not receiving other Taiwan government financial assistance, and not have received STRA within last 5 years.
funding_details: Monthly research allowance of NTD 25,000 for PhD students; NTD 40,000 for postdoctoral fellows. Economy class round-trip airfare reimbursement for most direct route.

title: Academia Sinica Taiwan International Graduate Program (TIGP)
application_deadline: Not publicly specified (check website for current cycle)
eligibility_summary: International students admitted to TIGP PhD programs. Top performers eligible for extended funding.
funding_details: Tax-free stipend of NT$40,000 per month (NT$34,000 + NT$6,000) for first year. For students who perform well, this scholarship/stipend will be extended for one more year. Further financial support depends on thesis advisor.
duration: First year guaranteed; extendable for second year based on performance; subsequent years dependent on advisor funding

title: NYCU International Student Scholarship
provider: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU)
application_deadline: Fall Semester: March 15; Spring Semester: September 15
application_opening_date: Fall Semester: January 15; Spring Semester: July 15
eligibility_summary: Current NYCU international students who have not received Taiwan government scholarships. Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 for graduate students and 3.0 for undergraduate students. Not eligible if currently receiving government-funded scholarships or holding working VISA/ARC.
funding_details: Monthly stipend (university-funded + match-funding from college/department/advisor) and tuition award (full tuition waiver or tuition charged at local student rates). Amounts flexibly adjusted based on budget.
duration: Generally 1 year per award; maximum 4 years (undergraduate), 2 years (master), 5 years (PhD)

title: NYCU Elite Ph.D. Scholarship
provider: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU)
eligibility_summary: New PhD students with outstanding grades who have not received scholarships or grants from the Taiwan government. Awarded based on recommendations from the college and review by the scholarship committee; not through direct student application.
funding_details: Monthly stipend of NT$33,000 plus full tuition waiver for 2 years.
